project_info.theme: Best packaging design award for Vinamilk Premium Gelato
project_info.color_palette: Chocolate brown, cream white, pastel cup colors, matcha green, cocoa brown

main_subject.detail: A clean studio award poster featuring three tall Premium Gelato cups topped with ice cream scoops: a pale cream scoop stack on a light-blue cup, green matcha scoops on a green cup, and chocolate scoops on a dark cup. On the left is the award badge '2026 WORLD DAIRY INNOVATION AWARDS WINNER' with the text 'BEST PACKAGING DESIGN 2026', 'THIẾT KẾ BAO BÌ XUẤT SẮC NHẤT 2026', and 'VINAMILK PREMIUM GELATO'. A Vinamilk 50th anniversary logo sits near the lower left.
main_subject.style: Premium packaging showcase poster, symmetrical studio food display, elegant award composition

composition_elements.text: 2026 WORLD DAIRY INNOVATION AWARDS WINNER; BEST PACKAGING DESIGN 2026; THIẾT KẾ BAO BÌ XUẤT SẮC NHẤT 2026; VINAMILK PREMIUM GELATO; PHUNG SU KHAT VONG VIET; EST; 1976; Vinamilk
items: Top Left: Floating World Dairy Innovation Awards winner badge on a brown studio backdrop
Top Right: Tall green gelato cup with stacked matcha scoops and syrup drips
Bottom Left: Vinamilk 50th anniversary logo and left-side award typography block
Bottom Right: Purple-based chocolate gelato cup and the lower half of the cream-colored and pink-based cups
Center/Background: Three colorful premium gelato cups elevated on pastel lid pedestals against a warm brown gradient background

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle pedestal shadows, crisp cup-print detail, glossy scoop highlights, clean product separation

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square premium packaging-award poster for Vinamilk Premium Gelato. Centerpiece is a photoreal studio lineup of three tall branded gelato cups topped with cream, matcha, and chocolate scoops. Include the exact text '2026 WORLD DAIRY INNOVATION AWARDS WINNER', 'BEST PACKAGING DESIGN 2026', 'THIẾT KẾ BAO BÌ XUẤT SẮC NHẤT 2026', and 'VINAMILK PREMIUM GELATO', plus the Vinamilk 50th anniversary logo near the lower left. Background is a warm chocolate-brown studio gradient with the cups standing on pastel-colored lid pedestals. Technical style: photoreal premium packaging advertising composite, soft premium studio lighting, glossy scoop highlights and crisp cup detail, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Vinamilk 50th anniversary logo
assets.usage: Place near the lower-left award-copy area

assets.name: Vinamilk Premium Gelato cup packaging set
assets.usage: Match the tall cup typography, flavor naming, and color system

assets.name: World Dairy Innovation Awards winner badge
assets.usage: Keep the badge floating on the upper-left side

assets.name: Packaging award announcement block
assets.usage: Preserve the English and Vietnamese award lines exactly

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This is an award-led packaging showcase. The 2026 reference is past relative to Friday, July 17, 2026, but should remain verbatim. Keep the three cups evenly staged and prioritize readable package graphics rather than abstract food styling.
